cohort: Nulliparous women giving birth to a singleton alive baby across all 36 states and 720 districts in India between 2016 and 2021.
finding: Between 2016 and 2021, national cesarean rates for nulliparous singleton births in India declined by 1.2 percentage points in public facilities but increased by 2.1 percentage points in private facilities, with pronounced regional disparities.
mod_finding: Cesarean rates for nulliparous singleton births in India increased in private hospitals (2.1 percentage points) but declined in public hospitals (1.2 percentage points) between 2016 and 2021, showing significant regional disparities.
cross-section timing: Data from two waves of India's National Family Health Survey collected between 2016 and 2021.
